cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closing time. I'll handle the office; you just check that window before you go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. My final check is that moving curtain. Could you confirm there's no draft?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the fan. I'll turn it off on my way out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, exactly my plan. Before you switch it off, show me the speed settings. Only the one you use, if you're in a hurry.
